blocks.text:
After breakfast, discover Lima with your guide.

The first stop is the Love Park in Miraflores, with Peruvian sculptor Víctor Delfín's sculpture “The Kiss”. The park opened on 14 February 1993. Its walls offer views of the ocean and are decorated like pages from a book of love poems.

Continue to the historic centre of Lima, passing through San Isidro, home to the city's main financial institutions.

On the Main Square stand the Government Palace, the Municipality and the Archbishop's Palace. You will also visit the Cathedral, with the tomb of Lima's founder Francisco Pizarro. Cathedral admission is included.

Next, visit the Santo Domingo Monastery and walk through its narrow corridors. Admission is also included.

Continue to Casa Aliaga, the Aliaga House. Founded in the 16th century on the foundations of an Inca pyramid, it is closely linked to the founding of Lima. Descendants of the Spanish conquistador Captain Aliaga still live here.

The house has 66 rooms, with some of its halls open to visitors. Its interiors preserve Cusco-school paintings, carved chests and other works of art.

At 18:00, visit the Magic Water Circuit. The complex consists of 12 computer-controlled fountains, some with jets reaching up to 80 metres.

Return to the hotel after the tour.

This day reveals very different sides of Lima. You begin above the Pacific in Miraflores, then explore the administrative buildings and churches of the historic centre, step inside the old Casa Aliaga mansion and end the day among illuminated fountains. At the Aliaga House, the layers of history are particularly clear: the colonial house stands on older foundations, while its interiors preserve Cusco-school paintings, carved furniture and works of art.
